title: Root systems, Weyl groups, and the Cartan-Killing classification, Part II: integral dominance and finite folding
summary: This Part II builds the finite integral dominance and diagram-folding direction above the existing root-system roadmap. It supplies one integral order, the Stembridge step, all finite orbit-sum folds including adjacent even A and component cycles, and the invariant coroot-step export with central directions retained. Two independent routed directions receive exhaustive split briefs and stable item assignments rather than incomplete mathematical nodes.
readme: The definitive reader document is research/blueprint/readmes/RootSystemsPartII.md. Work on finite reduced crystallographic root systems; use the existing integral positive cone and chamber APIs. The endpoint is an existential invariant positive-coroot orbit step. The affine Demazure/Newton and modular minuscule-bound directions are the two independent continuations proposed in the packet under PROTOCOL §9.

stages.title: Integral dominance and the Stembridge step
stages.description: Use the pinned positive root cone to define the integral dominance relation on an explicitly retained lattice. Establish its coefficient, translation and duality API, keeping rational dominance separate. Prove the positive-root step between distinct dominant integral endpoints by the maximal eligible root argument; apply the same theorem to the coroot pairing. The positive cone, chambers, root strings and their existing library proofs are inputs.

stages.title: Orthogonal diagram folding
stages.description: Define sums over distinct root orbits. For finite simply-laced systems with orthogonal simple orbits, construct the folded reduced crystallographic root system with its simple-orbit base and Cartan entries. Identify its Weyl group with the subgroup fixed under diagram conjugation, using the existing inversion and chamber-stabilizer API. Include identity, A3 reversal and D4 triality checks.

stages.title: Adjacent folding and component cycles
stages.description: Construct the orbit-sum B_n model for A_(2n) reversal, including the doubled middle pairing and nonunique short-root lifts. Build diagonal transport for cycles of irreducible components and their return automorphisms, including norm scaling and unchanged Cartan pairings. Prove the case split for a based automorphism of an irreducible system: it is the identity on a nonsimply-laced type, and its simple orbits are orthogonal except for the reversal of A_(2n). Combine this, read off the existing finite Dynkin classification, with orthogonal folding to obtain the fold for every based finite reduced crystallographic root-system automorphism.

stages.title: Invariant dominance and coroot orbit steps
stages.description: Prove forward weight-lattice integrality and equivalence of chambers under folding, with the adjacent pairing factor of two explicit. Identify the invariant integral positive root cone with the folded cone by coefficient uniqueness. Apply the ordinary Stembridge step in the fold to select a suitable positive orbit sum. Export the theorem to actual reductive cocharacter lattices while retaining central directions; distinguish the existential choice from summing arbitrary individually eligible increments.
